describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal creature in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on a flat pale surface with small patches of green grass and dirt under its feet and a soft gray shadow. The animal has the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, head, and paws of a brown bear, but bears glossy dark reddish-brown to black exoskeletal features. Its fur is dark chocolate brown on the back, sides, and outer legs, with longer, paler tan to cream fur on the muzzle, lower cheek, chest, and belly. The body is robust and low-slung with a thick neck, deep chest, and four sturdy columnar legs. A single large, smooth, glossy black horn curves up and backward from the middle of the forehead, with two small tooth-like points on its inner curve. Multiple smooth, shiny, segmented plates of the same dark color are embedded in the fur on the back, sides, neck, hips, and outer legs, and a row of six small dark oval openings sits in the pale fur on the lower flank below the large side plate. The illustration is rendered in a detailed natural-history style with highlights indicating gloss on the horn and plates.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal with dense shaggy brown fur standing in profile facing right. Its head, ears, bulky body, legs and clawed paws look like a brown bear, but a long glossy black curved horn with small prongs rises from its forehead, and multiple glossy dark reddish-brown segmented hard plates like beetle shell are set into the fur over its neck, shoulders, back, sides, hips and upper legs. A row of six small black oval spots sits in the pale fur on its flank beneath a large side plate.
